subject: number of columns in csv header does not match the data

messages.author: 6ad178c9bfa534b7
messages.subject: number of columns in csv header does not match the data
parts:
This is unusual. For the model attached, the csv produced by command line stan (v 1.1.0) has column headers that don't match the data. The header has 12,475 columns and the data 13,966 columns.  I can't figure out why this would happen with one model but not another, but it appears to be the case.

I attached the model (dfm2.stan), data (data.R),  the first few lines of the output (chain_1_head.csv), and an R script that has some of my investigations (foo.R).

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] number of columns in csv header does not match the data
parts:
I just submitted an issue regarding this problem:
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=87&colspec=ID%20Type%20Status%20Priority%20Owner%20Summary

In your model, this line causes the problem:
   delta <- X * beta_coef;

The quick solution is to resize the delta refined parameter to the correct size. Stan should disallow the assignment of a mismatched matrix, but it doesn't at the moment.


Daniel
